provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: 1962 reads `Ecclesiae` where 1862 reads `Eccl6sise`; 1962 reads `Scripturis` where 1862 reads `Scriptfins`; 1962 reads `Hieronymum, Confessorem` where 1862 reads `Hier6nymum, Confess6rem`; 1962 reads `Doctorem` where 1862 reads `Doct6rem`; 1962 reads `providere` where 1862 reads `provid6re`; 1962 reads `praesta, quaesumus;` where 1862 reads `prasta, qwesumus;`; 1962 reads `suffragantibus meritis, quod` where 1862 reads `suffragdnjibus m6ritis, qiiod`; 1962 reads `opere docuit,` where 1862 reads `6pere d6cuit,`; 1962 reads `exercere` where 1862 reads `exerc6re`; 1962 reads `Dominum.` where 1862 reads `D6minum.`; 1862 sets no comma after the ut; 1862 prints the j-orthography (ejus, adjuvante); 1862 layer damage is heavy in this oration (Scriptfins, prasta, qwesumus, suffragdnjibus, qiiod) but every damaged word is recoverable letter by letter and each is clean in the 1962; nothing is inferred that the surrounding letters do not fix; 1862 conclusion is the short cue and so is the 1962's here. Corroboration: 1922 Mame carries 30 September (PDF p. 840); not transcribed, the 1862 settles the reading.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui Ecclesiae tuae in exponendis sacris Scripturis beatum Hieronymum,
Confessorem tuum, Doctorem maximum providere dignatus es: praesta,
quaesumus; ut, ejus suffragantibus meritis, quod ore simul et opere docuit,
te adjuvante, exercere valeamus. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

translations.text: O God, Who didst vouchsafe to provide for Thy Church blessed Jerome, Thy confessor, a great Doctor for the expounding of the Sacred Scriptures, grant, we beseech Thee, that through his merits we may be enabled, by Thine assistance, to practise what both by word and deed he hath taught us. Through our Lord.
